degrees.novice: Teach an animal simple one-word commands (a week of training); number of commands = your Communication.
degrees.journeyman: Complex commands (2 weeks each); commands = Communication + 2.
degrees.master: A month of training raises an animal's Dexterity or Strength by 1 and gives it Willpower (Morale); only once per animal.

talents.name: Armor Training

degrees.novice: Leather and mail armor with no Dexterity penalty.
degrees.journeyman: Plate armor with no Dexterity penalty.
degrees.master: Gain half the armor's Armor Rating (rounded down) against penetrating damage.

notes: Without it, armor penalty applies to all Dexterity tests and calculations; with it only to Speed.

degrees.novice: Aim action gives +2 (instead of +1) with bow/crossbow.
degrees.journeyman: Reload a bow as a free action, a crossbow as a minor action.
degrees.master: Lightning Attack costs 2 SP with bow/crossbow (crossbow also needs Rapid Reload).

degrees.novice: +1 to each Dragon Die result when making Constitution (Drinking) tests in an advanced test.
degrees.journeyman: Choose Gambling or Seduction; if you fail a Communication test with it, re-roll (keep second).
degrees.master: Choose roleplaying stunt Flirt or Tower of Will; costs 3 SP (instead of 4) and +1 to the opposed roll.

degrees.novice: Heal is a minor action.
degrees.journeyman: Heal action restores (Dragon Die x 2) + Cunning.
degrees.master: Heal action restores (Dragon Die x 3) + Cunning.

degrees.novice: Major action heroic gesture: allies get +1 to Willpower (Courage) for the encounter.
degrees.journeyman: NPCs you lead get +1 initiative.
degrees.master: NPCs you lead don't test Morale until more than two-thirds of your side is out.

degrees.novice: Make a contact with a Communication (Persuasion) test (TN by GM).
degrees.journeyman: Ask a favor from a contact with another Persuasion test.
degrees.master: A significant favor turns a contact into an ally who will take risks for you.

degrees.novice: Free light wisp (10-yard radius); summon/dismiss are free actions.
degrees.journeyman: Creation spells cost 1 less mana (min 1); gain one new Creation spell.
degrees.master: +1 Defense; one new Creation spell.

talents.name: Dual Weapon Style

degrees.novice: Activate for +1 melee attack or +1 Defense vs melee until end of encounter (switchable with another Activate).
degrees.journeyman: Lightning Attack costs 2 SP (extra attack from the secondary weapon).
degrees.master: If you melee with the primary (not charging), a bonus attack with the secondary as a minor action; no stunt points, add half Strength to damage.

notes: Two one-handed weapons; the secondary weapon has Minimum Strength +2.

degrees.novice: Deathsight: see how many rounds until a creature you see at 0 Health dies.
degrees.journeyman: Entropy spells cost 1 less (min 1); one new Entropy spell.
degrees.master: Melee attackers suffer -1 Strength against you; one new Entropy spell.

degrees.novice: Mounting is a free action.
degrees.journeyman: Your mount gets +2 Speed.
degrees.master: +1 Defense while mounted; re-roll a failed Dexterity (Riding) test (keep second).

degrees.novice: Choose Etiquette, Deception, or Seduction; re-roll a failed Communication test with it (keep second).
degrees.journeyman: And Another Thing roleplaying stunt costs 1 SP (instead of 2); +1 on further tests it allows.
degrees.master: Stunned Silence costs 2 SP (instead of 3); may convert to combat with you and one ally per extra SP acting in round one while others are surprised.

talents.name: Linguistics

degrees.novice: One additional language.
degrees.journeyman: Another language; imitate dialects with Communication (Performance).
degrees.master: Two more languages; speak one known language without an accent.

notes: Languages: Ancient Tevene, Ander, Antivan, Arcanum, Dwarven, Elven, Orlesian, Qunlat, Rivaini, Trade Tongue (learn to speak and read; Ancient Tevene is rarely spoken, Elven spoken only through Keepers).

degrees.novice: Successful Cunning tests with a lore focus give an extra piece of information.
degrees.journeyman: +1 to each Dragon Die for Cunning (Research) in advanced tests.
degrees.master: Pick two lore focuses; re-roll a failed test with them (keep second).

talents.name: Mounted Combat Style

degrees.novice: Move part, attack, move the rest (total at most mount's Speed).
degrees.journeyman: Full mount Speed on a Charge and +1 damage on hit.
degrees.master: Knock Prone cannot dismount you.

notes: Two-handed weapons and long bows can't be used mounted.

degrees.novice: Play an instrument, sing, read/write music.
degrees.journeyman: Know instruments equal to Communication.
degrees.master: All common instruments; exotic ones in 1d6 weeks.

degrees.novice: Choose Empathy or Seeing; re-roll a failed Perception test with it (keep second).
degrees.journeyman: That Makes Me Wonder costs 2 SP (instead of 3).
degrees.master: The 'object of your attention' exploration stunt costs 2 SP (instead of 3) and gives +2 (instead of +1).

degrees.novice: Re-roll failed Persuasion when convincing a group (keep second; not individuals).
degrees.journeyman: 'Sway the crowd' stunt affects three additional people.
degrees.master: Persuasion to a group with Dragon Die 5-6 rouses them to immediate action.

talents.name: Poison-Making

degrees.novice: Choose 2 Novice poisons known from memory; brew others as you learn recipes.
degrees.journeyman: 1 Journeyman poison or grenade from memory; can make grenades.
degrees.master: 1 Master poison from memory.

notes: Details in Chapter 4: The Art of Poisoning.

degrees.novice: Treat enemies up to 4 yards away as adjacent (they can't do the same).
degrees.journeyman: Activate to 'set'; opponents must win an opposed attack roll to Skirmish you or use Two-Hander Novice move on you.
degrees.master: Military fork / two-handed spear: Pierce Armor costs 1 SP; glaive/halberd: Knock Prone costs 1 SP; mounted foes don't get the +1 vs foot.

degrees.novice: Free small flame in hand (not for combat); free actions to create/dismiss.
degrees.journeyman: Primal spells cost 1 less (min 1); one new Primal spell.
degrees.master: Mighty Spell stunt damage can hit additional targets (+1 SP each); one new Primal spell.

degrees.novice: Once per round, Ready is a free action.
degrees.journeyman: Go prone or stand as a free action.
degrees.master: Re-roll initiative at the start of combat (keep second).

degrees.novice: Inscribe Novice runes (2 hours; TN 13 Cunning (Enchantment) test speeds it up 15 min per Dragon Die degree).
degrees.journeyman: Journeyman runes (3 hours; TN 15).
degrees.master: Master runes (4 hours; TN 17).

degrees.novice: Re-roll a failed Dexterity (Stealth) test (keep second).
degrees.journeyman: Seize the Initiative costs 2 SP (instead of 4).
degrees.master: Re-roll a failed Perception (Seeing) test (keep second).

degrees.novice: Activate: +1 Defense until end of encounter while fighting in this style.
degrees.journeyman: Defense bonus becomes +2.
degrees.master: Attackers never gain outnumbering bonuses against you.

degrees.novice: Sense the mood of a creature within 6 yards as a minor action.
degrees.journeyman: Spirit spells cost 1 less (min 1); one new Spirit spell.
degrees.master: Re-roll mana regain dice (keep second); one new Spirit spell.

degrees.novice: Re-roll failed Dexterity (Lock Picking) (keep second).
degrees.journeyman: Re-roll failed Dexterity (Traps).
degrees.master: Re-roll failed Perception (Searching).

talents.name: Thrown Weapon Style

degrees.novice: +1 attack with throwing weapons.
degrees.journeyman: Reload throwing weapons as a free action.
degrees.master: Pierce Armor makes damage penetrating.

notes: Called 'Throwing Weapon Style' in the warrior class description.

talents.name: Trap-Making

degrees.novice: Traps up to 2d6 base damage and 1 extra effect; +1 to understand/disarm.
degrees.journeyman: Up to 4d6 and 2 effects; +2.
degrees.master: Up to 6d6 and any number of effects; +3.

notes: Details in Chapter 4: The Technique of Traps.

degrees.novice: On a hit with a two-handed melee weapon, move the target 2 yards.
degrees.journeyman: Mighty Blow costs 1 SP with a two-handed weapon.
degrees.master: Re-roll damage with a two-handed weapon (keep second).

degrees.novice: Fists do 1d6 (instead of 1d3).
degrees.journeyman: Knock Prone costs 1 SP with fist or gauntlet.
degrees.master: Disarm gets +2 on your attack roll in the opposed test.

degrees.novice: Full shield Defense bonus.
degrees.journeyman: Defensive Stance costs 1 SP.
degrees.master: Shield bonus +1.

talents.name: Spell Expertise
notes: Optional talent: unlocks the advanced spell stunts (see magic.json). The GM may allow all advanced stunts without it.

degrees.novice: Use the school stunt lists for each school talent you have, when casting that school.
degrees.journeyman: Also use the core advanced stunt list (non-school).
degrees.master: Use school stunt lists for every school you have a focus in.
